ShortDescription.Value: Plop any vanilla zoned building as a property-free scenery piece. Lot surfaces and randomized decorations (trees, benches, planters, bins) come with it, exactly like the game does it.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Static Scenery Ploppables
**English** | 中文见下方
Turn **any** vanilla zoned building into a **static, property-free scenery piece** you can place anywhere - no zoning requirements, no simulation load.
**What it does** - Browse all 2000+ vanilla zoned buildings in a Find It-style panel: search, zone tabs, and filters for density / level / width / depth. - Click an entry and place it. The building comes **with its vanilla lot surface and randomized decorations** - trees, benches, planters, bins, light poles. - Every placement rolls its own decoration variant with the game's own randomization, so no two placements are identical. - The result is a pure shell: **no residents, no jobs, no households, no companies, no simulation cost**.
**Compatibility and safety** - Decorations are created once, at placement time; missing decoration prefabs are skipped. - The vanilla relocate tool and bulldozing clean up lot surfaces correctly. - Uninstall-safe (verified): the save still loads and does not crash. Placed objects become missing-prefab placeholders (white models) and can be bulldozed together with their decorations. - No dependencies. Works alongside Find It, Move It, Anarchy and ctrlC.
**Localization**: panel text follows your game language - English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (BR), Russian, Polish, Japanese, Korean. Other languages fall back to English.
---
# 静态造景建筑
把**任意原版分区建筑**变成**静态、无属性、可随处放置**的造景件——不受分区限制，也不产生任何模拟负担。
**它做什么** - 在 Find It 式面板里浏览全部 2000+ 原版分区建筑：支持搜索、类型页签（住宅/商业/工业/办公），以及按密度、等级、面宽、进深筛选。 - 点击条目即可放置：建筑会连同**原版地皮**与**随机装饰**一起出现——树木、长椅、花盆、垃圾箱、灯杆等。 - 每次摆放都用游戏自身的随机逻辑抽一份装饰方案，所以没有两处完全相同。 - 放置结果是一栋纯净外壳：**没有居民、没有岗位、没有住户与公司、不产生模拟开销**。
**兼容与安全** - 装饰在放置那一刻一次性生成；缺失的装饰 prefab 会被跳过。 - 原版**迁移**与**拆除**都会正确清理地皮。 - **卸载安全（实测）**：移除模组后存档能正常载入、不崩溃；摆放物会变成白模占位，用推土机拆除白模时装饰一并清除。 - 无前置依赖，可与 Find It / Move It / Anarchy / ctrlC 共存。
**语言支持**：面板文案跟随游戏语言——English、简体/繁体中文、德文、法文、西班牙文、葡萄牙文（BR）、俄文、波兰文、日文、韩文；其余语言回退英文。
**源码与反馈**：https://github.com/LiangHaoXiang/StaticSceneryPloppables

ChangeLog.Value: 0.1.3: performance update - catalog build time 6.0s -> 3.6s (3397 -> 2077 prefabs, levels 2/4 are no longer built), package size 166 KB -> 74 KB (no pdb), the whole catalog is pushed to the UI once (search and filters now run instantly in the panel), orphan-lot cleanup removed (placement and relocation share the same engine pipeline); fixed a stray UI event warning in the log. 0.1.2: fix - the UI bundle (.mjs + images) is now guaranteed to be inside the package; without it the toolbar entry and panel were missing. 0.1.1: metadata update (bilingual description). 0.1.0: first public build - full vanilla zoned building catalog, Find It-style panel with search/zone/density/level/size filters, lot surfaces and randomized vanilla decorations, 11-language UI.
